finalMessage:
`slugify("Crème brûlée")` now returns `"creme-brulee"`, and the test suite passes (2/2).

The fix is in `src/index.js`. Before lowercasing, `slugify` now decomposes the input to NFKD and removes the combining marks, so "è" becomes "e" instead of being replaced by a dash. I also added the "Crème brûlée" case to the `slugify` test in `test/index.test.js`.

Characters that don't decompose, such as "ø" and "ß", still become dashes. I didn't add a transliteration table for those. I also didn't add a CHANGELOG entry, since you didn't ask for one.
